title: Life changing & adorable
body:
Finch is honestly one of the best self-care apps I’ve ever used. Instead of feeling like a boring to-do list, it turns daily habits and goals into something fun and motivating. You get to take care of a cute little bird while also taking care of yourself — and somehow that makes everything feel lighter and more achievable.

What I love most is how gentle and positive the app feels. It doesn’t judge you if you miss a day. Instead, it encourages you to try again. The daily check-ins, breathing exercises, reflections, and goal tracking are simple but really helpful, especially on stressful days.

The design is adorable, calming, and easy to use. Watching your Finch grow as you complete tasks is surprisingly motivating. It feels like your progress actually matters.

I would recommend Finch to anyone who wants to build better habits, improve their mental health, or just have a little extra positivity in their day. It’s perfect for students, busy people, or anyone who needs gentle encouragement.

body: I saw the app on TikTok and was not sure if it would be the one for me, as I had tried multiple similar apps for motivation and productivity. I don’t know why, but this one clicked for me. I managed to complete all my tasks for the day because I enjoy buying things for my birdie and sometimes when I feel lost throughout my day (when I can’t tell what I should be doing) I just look at what I had planned for myself in the morning using the app and I start doing that.
